set_sequence.description: Change sequence format: even width and height from 64 to 8192 pixels, frame rate from 1 to 120 fps, and name. These are the validated project limits.

set_work_area.description: Set the work/loop interval; end <= begin disables it.

set_transition.description: Set the incoming transition between the video clip and layers below; reset_progress restores automatic progress.

set_mix_channel.description: Set a track, bus or master channel. Gain is in dB, pan ranges from -1 to 1, and output 0 is master. Solo applies only to source tracks; master accepts gain and pan, while output, muted, locked, name and solo are rejected.
